name: Unreal Styles for Juggernaut XL
description: These models are an experiment in creating less realistic styles for my favourite realism model, Juggernaut X. I want to create Anime/Cartoon/Animation style images while preserving Juggernaut's ability to create detailed and accurate people, scenes and objects. The first beta model AnimeBlend2.5D is a mix of various 2.5D Anime styles. I've created some cool images with it, but I want to see how it works for other people so I can see how it needs to improve.
